messages:
maya: Heads up — after the site migration I noticed fragment links to /sdk/python/auth#token-flow are 404ing in prod (local mkdocs serve is fine). CI linkcheck didn't catch it. Anyone seen ghosting like this?

devon: I ran into something similar. MkDocs changed slug rules after the plugin bump; some headings got underscores instead of hyphens. The generated anchors no longer match our old links.

samir: Also saw a Docusaurus case where frontmatter `id` was omitted and anchor derived from title, which differs between builders. Might be a cross-tool inconsistency.

olga: Repro steps I used: 1) clone site, 2) mkdocs build -> inspect site/plugin-output, 3) run `mkdocs linkcheck --frag`. Command showed the page but different fragment id.

devon: Minimal repro snippet: ```markdown
## Token Flow (auth/token-flow)
```
becomes `#token_flow` with current slugify rules. Quick fix is to add an explicit HTML id or use an explicit header id: `## Token Flow {#token-flow}`.

maya: Can we prefer explicit ids in any headers we link to from other pages? That seems safer across builds. I'll open a tiny PR to add them for the auth pages.

devon: SGTM. One other thing — linkcheck CI by default ignores fragments for external redirects; add `--frag` to the job and run it in the deploy preview so we catch mismatch before prod.

docs-bot: deploy-preview: succeeded for branch `fix/auth-anchor-ids` (build 128) :white_check_mark:

olga: If we're adding explicit ids, let's list the affected files so the PR is scoped: `sdk/python/auth.md`, `guides/token-management.md`, `examples/auth-snippets.md`. I can do a quick pass.

samir: For Docusaurus pages, you can also set `slug` in frontmatter to control the final fragment. Might be worth a short doc note in CONTRIBUTING.md about adding ids when cross-linking.

maya: OK I'll add the ids + update CONTRIBUTING.md with a 2-line note. Assigning @devon for review. Will run linkcheck with `--frag` and post the deploy preview here. :pray:

devon: I'll review once the PR is up. If CI still misses anything, I'll attach the mkdocs-generated anchor map.

maya: Thanks everyone — closing the loop once preview is green.
